args: --help
exit: 0
--- stdout
Command-line utilities for genomic epidemiology research

Files are named by their paths; "stdin" or "-" reads an input from stdin, and "stdout" or "-" writes an output
to stdout. Any input can be gzipped. (--annotation can't be stdin, as its format comes from its suffix: use
--genbank or --gff.)

If you use gofasta in your work, please cite:

Jackson B (2022). gofasta: command-line utilities for genomic epidemiology research. Bioinformatics 38 (16), 4033-4035
https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btac424

Usage:
  gofasta [command]

Available Commands:
  closest     Find the closest sequence(s) to a query by genetic distance
  help        Help about any command
  licences    Print licence information
  sam         Convert SAM-format alignments to fasta format, and extract variants from SAM-format alignments
  updown      Get pseudo-phylogenetic-tree-aware neighbours by genetic distance from alignments
  variants    Annotate mutations relative to a reference from a multiple sequence alignment in fasta format

Flags:
  -h, --help      help for gofasta
  -v, --version   version for gofasta

Use "gofasta [command] --help" for more information about a command.
--- stderr
